name: Customer admin route compatibility hotfix
problem: The /admin-customers page could show Customer account access visual but fail loading /api/admin/customer_admin_list with HTTP 405 in some deployments.
fixes: Added generic onRequest dispatchers to customer_admin_list, customer_admin_detail, customer_admin_save, customer_admin_access_action, customer_account_help_list, and customer_account_help_action.
Kept method-specific handlers for Cloudflare Pages compatibility while ensuring generic dispatch can handle GET, POST, and OPTIONS.
Added a safe page-side GET fallback for list-style customer-admin calls if a deployment returns 405 on POST.
No customer passwords, token values, media storage, DAIP uploads, workers, public exports, or publishing routes were added.
manual_staging_test: Redeploy Pages/Functions together so the Functions route table refreshes.
Confirm /api/admin/customer_admin_list returns 200 or an auth-related response, not 405.
Select a customer and confirm detail/save/access actions call their endpoints without 405.
Clear the browser service-worker/cache if the previous admin page remains loaded.
daip_boundary: DAIP remains governed only; no production storage, upload, worker, AI, customer media, export, or public publishing capability is introduced by this hotfix.
